title: Guardians of the Galaxy
about: A scrappy band of misfits teams up to keep a powerful orb out of a fanatic's hands.
cue: Serve the snacks when Quill puts his mixtape on.

    StartersAwesome Mix pepperoni pizza rollsPuff pastry rolls filled with pizza sauce, pepperoni and mozzarellaHow to make it2 sheets of puff pastry3 tbsp pizza sauce16 slices of pepperoni60g mozzarella, grated1 tsp dried oregano1 egg, beaten2 tbsp parmesan, grated300ml napoli sauce1 tbsp honey1 pinch of chilli flakesHeat the oven to 200°C and line trays. Cut each pastry sheet into 8 rectangles.Top each with pizza sauce, pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano.Roll up, pinch the ends closed and lay seam down on the trays.Brush with egg, scatter with parmesan and bake until puffed and golden.Warm the napoli sauce with the honey and chilli flakes for dipping.Knowhere bar wingsBaked wings tossed in a sticky blackberry, soy, honey and chilli glazeHow to make it1kg chicken wings150g blackberries2 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp honey1 clove of garlic, crushed1 pinch of chilli flakesDry the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight.Bake at 220°C until crisp.Simmer the blackberries with the soy, honey, garlic and chilli until sticky, then strain.Toss the wings through the glaze.MainsRavager barbecue ribs with corn and slawSlow-baked paprika pork ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, grilled cornHow to make it1.5kg pork ribs1 tbsp smoked paprika2 tbsp brown sugar150ml barbecue sauce4 corn cobs300g coleslaw mix100ml mayonnaiseRub the ribs with paprika and sugar and wrap tightly in foil.Bake at 150°C until tender.Unwrap, brush with barbecue sauce and glaze under the grill.Grill the corn until charred.Toss the slaw mix with mayonnaise and serve.Missouri gochujang-glazed meatloafPeter's childhood home in Missouri, 1988How to make itAs written, serves 4Tender beef and pork meatloaf lacquered in a sticky gochujang, brown sugar and tomato glaze, sliced thick on creamy mash with buttered corn and onion gravy.Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk.Mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tsp mustard and salt.Shape into a loaf on a lined tray.Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 1 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar, brush half over and bake at 180°C for 50 minutes, adding the rest halfway.Rest 10 minutes.Serve with mash, buttered corn kernels and gravy from 1 sliced onion, 300ml beef stock and 1 tbsp cornflour.SweetsDance-off sundaesVanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream and rainbow sprinklesHow to tall glasses.Pour over the fudge and add whipped cream and sprinkles.Light a sparkler for the final move.DrinksGalaxy punchGrenadine, lemonade and blue raspberry cordial layered over ice, no
